premise: February Second repeats while the world chooses between honest continuity and a seamless imitation of tomorrow.
stakes_questions: Can change preserve a traceable relationship to what came before?
Will the right to pause survive the pressure to make the bell ring?
impending_outcome: A polished copy of tomorrow replaces continuity with performance and begins the same February Second again.

premise: An impossible commission waits between the atelier’s endless preparation and the jetty’s dangerous invitation to launch.
stakes_questions: Can visible care coexist with an imperfect first attempt?
Can ambition travel with consent, risk awareness, and a route home?
impending_outcome: Preparation becomes the world’s most elegant way of never making the thing.

premise: A luminous interpretation is circulating faster than the source path that could keep it corrigible.
stakes_questions: Can the play keep its emotional life without masquerading as a transcript?
Will audiences use the restored path rather than treating citation as decoration?
impending_outcome: The rendering hardens into unsupported history and becomes resistant to correction.
